About Organization

UP Environment Department is a government department in Uttar Pradesh, India. The department is responsible for protecting and conserving the environment in the state.

For more information, visit the official website of UP Environment Department.

About the Programme

The Junior Research Fellow programme is an outsourcing recruitment programme by UP Environment Department. The programme aims to recruit 25 Junior Research Fellows to work with the department.

The programme is open to candidates who have a Master's degree in Science and are CSIR-UGC NET qualified for JRF in Science Faculty.
